name: qlarr
description: Repo-root task runner for the two independent apps (frontend/, backend/). NOT an npm workspace root — each app installs and builds from its own folder. The root's only dependency is concurrently, used to run both apps together.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,magenta "npm start" "npm run backend:dev"
scripts.dev-debug: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,magenta "npm start" "npm run backend:debug"
